_about: The war economy (RULES.md §19) [balanced]. Each month every nation gets Manpower (= its 'rp' schedule in nations.json, spent on replacements) and Industry (= its 'munitions' schedule in nations.json × the difficulty multiplier, + 'industryBonus', + the industrial city effects, + research effects). Industry buys munitions for the stockpile (1 IP each, up to 'stockCap') or goes into research. 'cities': when the box is owned by the side that is NOT its 'holder', each nation in 'effects' gains or loses that much Industry. 'techs': 'historical' is the month the tech arrives free (null = it never happened, research only); 'earliest' is the first month it can be researched; 'effect' says what it does (see docs/DATA.md); 'replaces' names the event or reinforcement it replaces so it can't happen twice. See docs/DATA.md.

cities.note: Paris: the heart of French industry
Amiens: the rail hub behind the Somme
Channel Ports: every British shell came through them
Lille: French textile and coal country, held by Germany since 1914
Sedan–Mézières: the railway that fed the German front

techs.name: Creeping barrage
techs.note: A curtain of shells moving ahead of the infantry; first used widely on the Somme in 1916.

techs.name: Landships
techs.text: The first British Tank unit arrives.
techs.note: The Admiralty's Landships Committee built the Mark I; it first went into action at Flers in September 1916.

techs.name: Renault FT
techs.text: The June 1918 French Tank unit arrives now.
techs.note: The first tank with a turret that turned all the way round; Renault's factories built thousands in 1918.

techs.name: Heavy artillery programme
techs.note: France ended the war with about 6,000 heavy guns. This programme starts the surge sooner.

techs.name: Defence in depth
techs.text: Germany's Defence in depth trait (§4) starts.
techs.note: After the Somme, German doctrine moved from holding the front line to an outpost zone, a battle zone and counter-attack divisions.

techs.name: Stormtroop tactics
techs.text: Up to 4 German infantry units become Stormtroopers.
techs.note: Small assault groups that bypassed strongpoints, tried at Riga and Caporetto in 1917.

techs.name: A7V tanks
techs.text: Germany gains 1 Tank unit, its only one.
techs.note: Only about 20 A7Vs were built. Here Germany can choose to build enough for one unit.
